items.title: Lonnie Liston Smith interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 9, 2021
items.q: And they were with Sri Chinmoy. That’s where Santana gets all its spirituality from. And even Narada Michael Walden, they were all in there together. And I came in right after they left

ctx.x: Could you have written a song like “A Garden of Peace” if you were in turmoil? If your spirit was not at peace? If you weren’t at peace yourself?

Right. I don’t think so because I always took my time dealing with life. And then at one time I was with, you know I found out, I was with Sri Chinmoy because Santana and Mahavishnu, the guy who started Mahavishnu, John McLaughlin.
